_doc: Emberwick, on Volcano (re-cut 2026-11-25: song bars 36-42, 48-65; the journey 2026-11-26). Four places: bars 0-3 the Ash Moon, cold, every good tap warming it (a bellows at bar 1, the first embers in the air at bar 3); bar 4 the Kindling's fling, four beats in the air with two embers to tap, onto the forge ring; 5-7 the forge ring, the Meteor given (5), the first vent (6), the build tightening (7: no reversal before the drop); 8 the drop as built (1.5x, the beat of stillness, the impact, the forge bursting), then Ossa's strike flings him out to the lava moons (20.4); the Crucible (an ellipse), her strike at 24.0 to the Twins (a figure-eight crossing on the bar line at 26.4), her strike at 28.8 to the Slag Bridge (straight), her strike at 33.6 back to Emberwick; every flight in the drop has an ember to tap; 14-15 the dive, a spiral into the forge, the camera pulling back to show the whole system relit, then tipping in; 16-23 inside the heart, the forge's bellows (18), the sprint (19-21); 24 the seal.
Every bar is charted by hand (presses.json). Swung sixteenths. The id is the world's slot, not the song: saves, scenes and stars are kept under it.
title: Volcano (feat. Scarlett)
adds: The Meteor: tap to dash through walls

setpieces.name: The Kindling's fling
setpieces.what: the Kindling curls into a ring of sparks at the Ash Moon's rim and throws him across to Emberwick: four beats in the air, two embers to tap, the landing shown before he goes

setpieces.name: The Meteor
setpieces.what: he lands on the forge ring and the Kindling gives the Meteor; Ossa's anvils stand across the ring

setpieces.name: The forge relights
setpieces.what: a speed portal on the drop (1.5x); a beat of stillness, then the impact and the forge bursting

setpieces.name: Ossa's strike
setpieces.what: her blow throws a ring of fire out from her hearth-stone; it reaches him on the beat and flings him out to the lava moons

setpieces.name: To the Twins
setpieces.what: her next strike: a two-beat flight with an ember to tap, onto a figure-eight round two moonlets, crossing between them on the bar line

setpieces.name: The Slag Bridge
setpieces.what: her strike throws him onto a straight causeway of crust over the dark, running back toward Emberwick

setpieces.name: The dive
setpieces.what: her last strike throws him back to Emberwick; the camera pulls back to show the whole system relit, comes in for the forge's bellows on the breath (36.0), and tips into the forge's mouth as the path winds inward

setpieces.name: Inside the heart
setpieces.what: the last stretch runs inside the planet's glowing heart: the forge's bellows (43.2), vents (40.8, 48.0)

setpieces.name: The forge sprint
setpieces.what: a fast portal (2x) at the peak of the second half, three bars, then back to 1.5x

setpieces.name: The seal
setpieces.what: the last wall is the Stillness's seal on the star; one dash on the song's last stab breaks it and the star bursts free
